headline: US President Donald Trump hopes to meet PM Tarique soon
summary: In a letter to the Prime Minister, Trump expressed confidence in Bangladesh's bright future under Tarique's leadership and thanked him for the Boeing aircraft purchase.
details: US President Donald Trump has expressed his hope to meet Prime Minister Tarique Rahman soon in a direct meeting.
The information was shared by Atikur Rahman Rumn, the Additional Press Secretary to the Prime Minister, regarding a letter sent by Trump on Monday, August 31.
In the letter, Trump stated his firm belief that Bangladesh and its people have a bright future under the leadership of Tarique Rahman, despite various challenges.
The US President also extended his sincere greetings and love to the people of Bangladesh.
Additionally, Trump thanked the Prime Minister for the decision to purchase Boeing aircraft from the United States.
He assured that Boeing would not disappoint Bangladesh and noted that he would always remember the Prime Minister's personal attention to this matter.
caption:
Donald Trump wants to meet PM Tarique Rahman. The US President expressed confidence in Bangladesh's bright future under his leadership.

US President Donald Trump has expressed his hope to meet Prime Minister Tarique Rahman soon in a direct meeting.

The information was shared by Atikur Rahman Rumn, the Additional Press Secretary to the Prime Minister, regarding a letter sent by Trump on Monday, August 31.

In the letter, Trump stated his firm belief that Bangladesh and its people have a bright future under the leadership of Tarique Rahman, despite various challenges.

The US President also extended his sincere greetings and love to the people of Bangladesh.

Additionally, Trump thanked the Prime Minister for the decision to purchase Boeing aircraft from the United States.

He assured that Boeing would not disappoint Bangladesh and noted that he would always remember the Prime Minister's personal attention to this matter.

#Bangladesh #USA #DonaldTrump #TariqueRahman #Diplomacy #Boeing

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV

details: A disturbing trend has emerged where National ID (NID) details, call records, and real-time location data of individuals are being sold illegally online.
